# Original v15 compatibility fixture

`v15-custom.slpz` was encoded with commit `b66dd55`, before removing legacy
support and renumbering the format to v1. Its 15 members are synthetic inputs generated by `make_fixtures()`
in `../test_archive.py`; it contains no collected replays or user data.
The fixtures cover valid and older Slippi records, exceptional float bits,
empty/opaque/truncated input, unused/zero-width declarations, cross-file pools,
and opaque single-frame and chunked PowerPC payloads.

The normal test suite decodes this fixed archive with both its original v15
header and the equivalent v1 header and compares every byte to
the independently regenerated inputs. A compatibility reader can additionally
check encoder agreement (apart from the version byte) at levels 1, 3, 7, and 9:

```sh
python3 tests/test_archive.py --reference /path/to/slpz-compat
```

To reproduce the fixture, use the `b66dd55` executable explicitly:

```sh
python3 tests/test_archive.py --reference /path/to/slpz-compat --write-golden
```
